Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: compound_structures, molecule_dictionary, activities. Join: compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217643', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, molecule_chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
